title: Wunderkind Config
description: Schema for Wunderkind global and project configuration files.

region.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global region default.

industry.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global industry default.

primaryRegulation.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global primary regulation default.

secondaryRegulation.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global secondary regulation default.

cavemanEnabled.description: Enable project-default caveman mode for terse, high-signal replies when value is preserved.

promptOptimizationEnabled.description: Enable the separate supplementary prompt optimization engine. This does not change the audit-only token-audit contract or surface.

promptOptimizationMode.description: Runtime optimization mode for the separate supplementary engine: off disables it, advisory measures/report budgets, and active allows bounded trimming of supported sections only without changing the audit-only token-audit surface.

promptOptimizationReportingMode.description: Opt-in runtime reporting posture for the separate runtime-report surface. persist and summary keep sanitized/redacted latest-report artifacts or summaries under .wunderkind/runtime/prompt-optimization/ without changing the audit-only token-audit surface.

promptOptimizationTokenBudget.description: Optional token budget used only when the current model matches the supported exact OpenAI map.

promptOptimizationByteBudget.description: Optional byte-budget fallback for unsupported or unset models when operators still want bounded runtime behavior.
